title: Lucy McBath addresses reproductive rights and gun safety on SCOTUS ruling anniversary
text:
Lucy McBath addresses reproductive rights and gun safety on SCOTUS ruling anniversary
N. C. Landry
Rep. Lucy McBath, U.S. Congresswoman representing Georgia’s 7th district since 2019, posted a series of statements on June 24, 2026, marking the anniversary of the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and reaffirming her positions on reproductive rights and gun violence prevention.
In a tweet posted at 16:30 UTC, McBath reflected on the four-year anniversary of the Supreme Court ruling that overturned Roe v. Wade, stating, "Today marks four years since SCOTUS overturned Roe v. Wade. Reproductive care is health care. Your personal decisions belong to you and no one else."
One minute later, she addressed efforts to maintain access to mifepristone by highlighting her participation in an amicus brief and referencing the consequences of the Dobbs decision, "I was proud to join my colleagues in signing on to an amicus brief in defense of mifepristone access. We've seen the life-threatening consequences of the Dobbs decision for families across our country. I'm standing on the side of protecting reproductive freedoms."
Later that day at 17:30 UTC, McBath reiterated her commitment to advancing legislation aimed at preventing gun violence, "I remain committed to advancing legislation that protects our children and prevents the next tragedy before it occurs. We owe it to every family touched by gun violence, and to every family we can still protect, to meet this moment with courage and conviction."
McBath has represented Georgia’s 7th district since replacing Karen Handel in 2019 (https://ballotpedia.org/Lucy_McBath). She won re-election in 2024 against Jeff Criswell with nearly three-quarters of the vote (74.7%) (https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2024/11/05/us/elections/results-georgia-us-house-district-7.html). Born in Joliet, Illinois in 1960 and currently residing in Marietta, McBath graduated from Virginia State University with a BA in 1982.
